question.text: <math><mn>4</mn></math> different balls of green colour and <math><mn>4</mn></math> different balls of red colour are to be distributed equally among <math><mn>4</mn></math> people. The probability that all <math><mn>4</mn></math> people have balls of a different colour is <math><mi>λ</mi></math>, then the value of <math><mn>7</mn><mi>λ</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Total cases = number of ways in which 4G and 4R balls are distributed equally among 4 people
=8!2!4×14!×4!
Favourable cases = all 4 people have balls of different colour
=4!4!
Required probability =4!×4!8!×2!4
=835
